2 · Depth

Depth Pro 2 (B): sharp near field, but every ridge beyond ~1 km is returned as infinitely far. DA3-SMALL: keeps ridge order (ρ = 0.68 vs NPS chart), raw metres invalid; scale set from map anchors. Depth Pro 2 weights are research-only.

3 · Arkansas

single frame · preliminary · no local monitor

Reading: Good, PM2.5 ≈ 3 µg/m³ (range 0–49). Extinction 24 Mm⁻¹.

ARDOT camera 9004 (Hwy 16 eastbound, probably Edwards Junction): nearest regulatory PM2.5 monitor is Springdale, 77 km away. The Tunnel Tower camera (ID 304, I-49) is 46 km from it. Most of this view is a nearby tree slope, so the reading rests mainly on one distant band.

Reference: NPS on-site monitor (TEOM) at Look Rock, read from the NPS AirWebCams archive. Not an EPA file; TEOMs can read low in heavy smoke. Calibration is per season: a June 2016 test did not transfer. Deployment on ARDOT cameras needs ARDOT permission.
